Draft Emoji List for 2027/2028 Unveiled

Unicode has released its first draft list for Emoji 19.0 with just five candidates, including a vulture, an orchid, an inukshuk and a pair of eyes looking right. If approved as-is, it would be the smallest Unicode emoji release ever. Here's what’s proposed and when you might see them.

Classic Noto Color Emoji Lives On As Google Debuts Emoji 18.0 Support

On the same day that Unicode 18.0 and Emoji 18.0 have been formally approved, Google has released its designs for the latest set of new emojis in its classic Noto Color Emoji font as well as its monochrome Noto Emoji font.

What's New In Unicode 18.0

Today the latest list of new emoji recommendations has been approved by the Unicode Consortium, confirming new additions such as the Cracking Face, the Pickle, the Meteor, the Lighthouse, and the Eraser.
